CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetToken

Splits a string into tokens at any of the delimiter characters and returns the token at the given position.

Category

String functions

Syntax

GetToken(string, index [, delimiters ])

Parameters

string
The string to take apart.
index
Which token to return, counting from 1.
delimiters
Optional. A string of delimiter characters; each one separates tokens. Default: space, tab, carriage return and line feed.

Returns

The token, or an empty string if there are fewer tokens than index.

Usage

Runs of delimiters count as a single break, so "one two" (two spaces) still has two tokens. Unlike ListGetAt, an index past the end is not an error: you simply get an empty string, which makes GetToken convenient for parsing lines from a text file.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Line = "Sales    Boston   MA  02110">
<CFSET Path = "C:\CFUSION\CustomTags\cf_hello.cfm">
<CFOUTPUT>
<UL>
<LI>Token 2 of "#Line#": #GetToken(Line, 2)#
<LI>Token 4: #GetToken(Line, 4)#
<LI>Token 9: [#GetToken(Line, 9)#]
<LI>Token 3 of the path, split at "\": #GetToken(Path, 3, "\")#
</UL>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListGetAt, SpanExcluding, Mid, ListLen
